Job Title: Senior Frontend Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer to build modern, performant web applications.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with React, TypeScript, and JavaScript (ES6+).
- Strong proficiency in modern CSS (Tailwind CSS, Sass, HTML5).
- Hands-on experience with state management (Redux, Zustand) and API integration (REST API, GraphQL).
- Experience with frontend build tools (Vite, Webpack) and automated testing (Jest, Cypress).
- Knowledge of Node.js, Next.js, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines is a strong plus.
